Chapter 456: Chapter 5 Lin Yuan’s Strength (Please Subscribe)_2

“`

As for the Divine Skill ‘Mountain Moving,’ Lin Yuan had too little time in the Main World to fully comprehend the Divine Ability Imprint of ‘Mountain Moving.’

…

He returned to the Martial Temple.

Before long,

a few Supreme Elders made their way over.

...

“Elder,”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Over the past century, the Supreme Elders of the Martial Temple had treated Lin Yuan quite well, nurturing him almost like the future of the Martial Temple.

If it hadn’t been for the support of the Martial Temple in the early stages, Lin Yuan would have definitely reached this point today, but it would have taken a lot more time.

Cultivators of the Immortal Path need resources,

and so do Martial Dao Cultivators.

Especially at the Sixth and Seventh Ranks, when opening up an Inner World, the consumption of resources is as vast as mountains and seas.

“Chang Er, here is the Immortal Path Skill you asked for,” the Great Supreme Elder took out several Jade Slips, looking at Lin Yuan, his gaze uncontrollably showing a trace of trepidation.

As early as seventy or eighty years ago, they, the Supreme Elders, had already found Lin Yuan unfathomable.

Lin Yuan had browsed through all the countless Martial Tao scriptures recorded in the Martial Temple, and although they hadn’t directly sparred in strength,

every close contact with Lin Yuan gave them an inexplicable feeling of palpitation.

This sensation had disappeared sixty years ago, but they had no intention of underestimating Lin Yuan.

They just felt that Lin Yuan might have achieved the level of returning to the original purity? This was what several elders at the Seventh Stage Martial Tao thought.

Unless they deliberately demonstrate their aura, they look no different from ordinary people.

“Supreme Jade Purity Immortal Scripture, this is the secret core skill of the Supreme Immortal Sect?” Lin Yuan became interested.

In recent decades, Lin Yuan had asked the Supreme Elders to collect as many Immortal Path Skills as possible.

Although the Supreme Elders did not know what the purpose was for Lin Yuan, a Martial Path Cultivator, to collect Immortal Path Skills,

Lin Yuan’s displayed talent and divine abilities were too frightening for them to harbor any doubts.

Lin Yuan quickly browsed through the ‘Supreme Jade Purity Immortal Scripture’ and finally nodded slightly, “Although it ends after the Divinity Transformation Stage, the Supreme Immortal King, as a Supreme Immortal King that commands respect across three thousand Dao Provinces, has indeed created a scripture with value.”

Lin Yuan commented with a hint of admiration in his voice.

Even among Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings, there are differences in strength, and the Supreme Immortal Kings are the peak powerhouses among those in the Tribulation Transcendence Stage. Lin Yuan guessed that the Supreme Immortal Kings might correspond to the invincible at the Eighth Layer in the Main World.

“The Supreme Immortal Sect once intended to disseminate the Supreme Jade Purity Immortal Scripture and allowed other cultivators to practice this scripture, otherwise we wouldn’t have been able to obtain it,” said the Great Supreme Elder, nodding his head.

The purpose of the Supreme Immortal Sect’s move was easy to guess: they were simply scouting for talents across three thousand Dao provinces suited to cultivate the Supreme Jade Purity Immortal Scripture.

The scriptures that the Supreme Immortal Sect spread only ranged from the Qi Cultivation Chapter to the Mahayana Chapter.

Even if some idle Immortal Path cultivators were fortunate enough to begin practicing, the only way to delve further would be to head to the Supreme Clarity Immortal Sect.

“Chang Er…,”

the Great Supreme Elder hesitated for a moment before he finally asked.

“What is your current Realm, the Seventh Stage Martial Tao?”

The Great Supreme Elder asked cautiously.

In a mere hundred years, reaching the Seventh Stage of Martial Arts would have been utterly unbelievable to the Great Supreme Elder in the past.

But Lin Yuan’s performance in the past century caused the Supreme Elders to entertain such a thought.

Being at the Sixth Rank themselves, and feeling a sense of pressure from him, it was highly probable that Lin Yuan was at the Seventh Rank.

“My current Realm?”

Lin Yuan smiled faintly.

The other Supreme Elders, upon hearing this, instinctively pricked up their ears to listen.

They too were curious about Lin Yuan’s current strength.

“No.”

Lin Yuan shook his head.

He had progressed beyond the Seventh Stage Martial Tao sixty years ago.

“Not the Seventh Stage Martial Tao?” The Great Supreme Elder breathed a sigh of relief, feeling a complex mix of emotions.

He hoped Lin Yuan was at the Seventh Stage Martial Tao because that would mean the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had birthed another Seventh Rank ancestor, which would further expand the influence of the Martial Temple.

“`

“`

But rationally, the Great Supreme Elder did not believe that, within merely a hundred years, Lin Yuan could have reached the Seventh Rank, which seemed absolutely inconceivable.

Now that Lin Yuan had confirmed it, the doubts in the hearts of the Supreme Elders were no more.

From beginning to end.

Neither the Great Supreme Elder.

Nor the other Supreme Elders, had ever considered that Lin Yuan could be at the Eighth Stage of Martial Arts.

Because that was simply a fantasy, ever since the Martial Path Evolutionary Path came into existence, the strongest among them was at the Seventh Rank, stopping at the level of a True Immortal on the Immortal Path.

The Eighth Stage of Martial Arts? Even the legendary Martial Ancestor hadn’t delved into that, let alone Lin Yuan, such a fledgling who had only practiced for a hundred years.

“If not the Seventh Rank, then it must be the Sixth Rank.”

“A hundred years to reach the Sixth Rank, in the Martial Temple since its establishment, such a cultivation speed can be called unrivaled.” The Great Supreme Elder thought silently to himself.

Over tens of thousands of years, countless Martial Dao prodigies streaked across the sky, but there had never been one that entered the Sixth Rank within a hundred years.

The Sixth Rank of Martial Dao corresponds with the level of an Ancient Saint of Refinement Void on the Immortal Path. To reach the level of an Ancient Saint of Refinement Void in a hundred years, only those monstrous talents on the Immortal Path, the Immortal King Seeds, stand a chance of doing so.

…

After the Supreme Elders left.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in his cave dwelling.

“My current Dao strength…” Lin Yuan began to examine himself, with the help of many methods, even without the amplification from an Inner World spanning over ten million li, Lin Yuan’s combat power was approaching invincible at the Eighth Rank.

If he used the Divine Skill ‘Strengthening’, within ten breaths, Lin Yuan’s combat power might even far exceed that of an invincible Eighth Rank.

“It’s just, I wonder what the Power of Creation wielded by Immortal King level powerhouses is all about?” Lin Yuan secretly thought to himself.

After years of understanding, Lin Yuan roughly confirmed that Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings probably did not possess an Inner World.

What they relied on was the Power of Creation they wielded. Ordinary Immortals wielded portions of the Power of Creation’s might, while Supreme Immortal Kings wielded the complete Power of Creation.

“Unfortunately, there are no Immortal King level powerhouses in Dongyun Tao Province…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. Even when considering the three thousand Tao provinces, Immortal King level powerhouses were extremely rare, let alone having such powerhouses stationed in Dongyun Tao Province.

Otherwise, Lin Yuan would probably try his hand against one or two Immortal Kings.

As for outside Dongyun Tao Province, the distance was too far. Even though Lin Yuan’s mastery of Space Rules allowed him to cover millions or tens of millions of li in one step, it would still take a substantial amount of time to reach the next Tao Province.

With the effort it took to travel that far, Lin Yuan might as well spend more time in secluded cultivation.

As for Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings, even if he went to another province, whether he could find a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King was another matter.

“It’s time to bring over that gourd.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. Now that his strength was sufficient, at least within the bounds of Dongyun Tao Province, he was invincible. Even if there were hidden Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings, it was likely that they couldn’t defeat Lin Yuan.

Therefore, he currently had the power to protect that Mysterious Gourd.

Hum.

Thinking this.

Lin Yuan’s mind began to sink into the depths of his mind.

Looking towards that majestic and vast Door to the Myriad Realms.

“Crossing dimensions, crossing latitudes, beyond imagination.”

Even though he had observed the Door to the Myriad Realms more than once, Lin Yuan still felt a sense of awe strike him.

When he first became an Evolver, Lin Yuan looked at the Door to the Myriad Realms and felt only its magnificence and vastness, but now, he saw this Gate of Light as if it were a colossal entity straddling boundless worlds.

“Through these hundred years, everything seems normal in the Main World; nothing much has happened.”

Lin Yuan could faintly sense the situation on the side of his True Body in the Main World through the Door to the Myriad Realms.

“Let’s begin.”

With a thought, Lin Yuan expended a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force to start transporting the Mysterious Gourd from the Main World to this place.

Swish swish.

In the center of the Door to the Myriad Realms, space fluctuations faintly emerged.

These fluctuations were profound and remote, as if emanating endless mystery.

Lin Yuan carefully felt it. This method of transporting items through dimensional latitudes far exceeded his current understanding. By observing a little longer, he might, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, be able to comprehend something new.

After a moment.

The space fluctuations gradually subsided.

A dusky yellow gourd slowly emerged.

Landing into Lin Yuan’s palm.
